disputes.reason: Correct option (below 3.6m) rests on an unstated timing convention: the setup says the OC account earns 3.5% but not that the year-2 recoveries earn nothing in year 2. If they earn interest (3.6 x 3.5% = 0.126) the closing balance is about 3.68m, above 3.6m. The 0.049m margin from 3.6m is too thin to be convention-proof, and the wrong option 'Above 3.6m' is defensible.
The why text on the 95% option is corrupted: '\text' was written with a single backslash in the JSON and decodes to a TAB plus 'ext{SMM}', so the math in the feedback is garbled and will not render.
